answer: A beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each agent keeps a sable ledger and posts a heartbeat each epoch; the beacon samples a random few, and a raven check asks them to prove that work before a one-block ridge deadline. Missing it slashes a 20-unit bond and freezes the identity 10 epochs. Running 100 fakes costs 100 x (20 + 5) = 2,500 units for a 30-unit reward, while an honest agent pays 25 once and keeps its share undiluted.
